# CommentPinShowcase - Caller-positioned comment pins over media and in a content margin. Every coordinate maps to the pin's logical bottom-start corner. The selected group caps its participants at three circles (two Avatars plus an ellipsis) and ends with its total and an accent unread dot; the unread margin pin shows the dot too. Other pins dim without becoming disabled, activating the selected pin again clears the selection, and no pin dims while nothing is selected.
